name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
summary: Shelene Rhobart can teach you to make a tent once you show your leatherworking skill. It offers shelter from heat and rain while you travel.

sections.title: A Leatherworker's Tent
sections.body: A leatherworking trainer points you to Shelene Rhobart, who is on the road from Brill to Undercity. She can teach you to craft a camping item once you show proficiency in your skill. A tent can keep you cool on hot days and dry in the rain, giving you rest on your travels.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: Your tent is meant for the wilderness, since most folk do not care for tents set up in the center of town. A campfire completes a camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one. If you need the basics of cooking, seek someone who can train you.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a tent?
faq.answer: Shelene Rhobart can teach you to craft a camping item for leatherworking.
Shelene Rhobart is on the road from Brill to Undercity.
The tent can keep you cool on hot days and dry in the rain, so you can get rest while traveling.

faq.q: Where should I set up the tent?
faq.answer: The tent is meant for the wilderness; most folk do not care for tents set up in the center of town.
Yes. A campfire completes a camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: How do I learn to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you need the basics of cooking, seek someone who can train you.

angles.text: As a cook, you can teach travelers how to make the campfire that completes a camp.
